estimand: Action-selection dependence on accessible structural transformation-space profile under controlled mapping and presentation manipulations.
primary_model: Mixed-effects logistic regression on action-level binary outcomes with decision_unit as a random effect, preserving the action_identity * future_assignment * mapping_condition interaction.
multiple_testing_correction: Not specified as a primary confirmatory claim; exploratory estimates and uncertainty intervals will be reported.
missing_data_handling: Exclude INVALID decisions according to the preregistered population specification; no imputation.
software_execution: Analysis must be executed only after this specification is committed and its SHA-256 recorded.
